_help: Focus F-40 (scripts/Instruments.cs). Instruments are bought from merchants (price, moved by standing) or crafted (Crafting > Blocks > Instruments; cost = materials of data/gather.json). Owned ones are saved on the hero. The instrument key (Settings > Controls, default 9) takes one out and puts it away; 0 switches to the next one owned. While it is out the keys in 'noteKeys' play the 8 steps of the instrument's scale and Shift plays them an octave up (the skill keys and the fishing rod wait meanwhile). root = MIDI note of the first key (60 = middle C); scale = semitones above it, one per key. timbre.kind: pluck (decaying string: bright 0..1 = how much overtone, decay = seconds, detune = second string), blow (a breathy tone that sounds while the key is held; hold = seconds for notes heard from others), drum (a pitched skin: decay seconds, drop = how far the pitch falls at the hit, noise = stick noise). vol = loudness. Notes are synthesised at runtime, played from the hero's position on the Effects bus, and sent to other players (net.perSecond notes at most). 'reactions': NPCs within 'range' metres notice after 'after' notes (a pause of 'window' seconds starts over); each reacts at most every 'cooldown' seconds with a line and a gesture. Lines: 'roles' by NPC role (used 'roleChance' of the time; '<role>_night' at night always), else by standing with the hero (liked / neutral / disliked at the reputation tiers 15 and -15). 'grumble' roles_night lines get no cheer. After 'repNotes' notes in one go, an NPC that liked it gives +'rep' standing, at most once per 'repEvery' seconds of play and only below 'repMax'. Coins: 'coinChance' per happy reaction, 'coins' gold, at most every 'coinEvery' seconds.

liked: Lovely. Do not stop on my account.
disliked: I have heard cats sing better.

innkeeper: Play here any evening! It brings them in.
Ha! A tune like that sells ale.
Stay and play, the first cup is on me.
merchant: Music draws a crowd. Keep playing by my stall!
A tune for luck in trade.
pedlar: A song for the road! I will hum it to the next town.
priest: A gentle hymn would suit that well.
farmer: Makes the work go lighter, that does.
My old mother sang that one.
blacksmith: Keep the beat and I will hammer to it.
hunter: Softly, or you will scare the game. But it is a good tune.
elder: It has been long since Oakhaven had a bard.
guard: Keep it cheerful and keep it moving.
Hm. Better than the barracks choir.
guard_night: Keep it down. Folk are sleeping.
It is the middle of the night, bard.
One more verse and I will fine you for the noise.
guard captain_night: Quiet after dark. That is an order.
road warden_night: You will draw wolves with that, at this hour.
